cards.name: Batch
cards.summary: Plays one recorded action on every file in a folder (or on imported, opened or Bridge-selected files) and can save the results to another folder with a naming scheme. Nothing happens to the current document unless it is one of the sources.
use_for: resizing, watermarking or recoloring a whole folder of product photos with one recorded action
converting a folder of PSDs to flattened JPEGs for a client handoff
applying the same social-crop action to every image of a campaign
avoid: an action that contains its own Open / Save As steps without ticking the Override options: files open or save in the wrong place
unattended runs where an action step shows a dialog: the batch stops and waits; record the action without modal steps or log errors to a file
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('batch'), undefined, DialogModes.ALL) opens the Batch dialog (run live 2026-10-04). Without UI: app.batch(inputFiles, action, from, options) with a BatchOptions (destination, destinationFolder, overrideOpen, overrideSave, fileNaming, startingSerial, errorFile ...) (harvested Application.batch and BatchOptions; behaviour unverified).
cards.how: Play: pick the action Set and Action. Source: Folder (Choose), Import, Opened Files or Bridge; Override Action "Open" Commands, Include All Subfolders, Suppress File Open Options Dialogs, Suppress Color Profile Warnings. Destination: None, Save and Close, or Folder; Override Action "Save As" Commands; File Naming from up to six elements (document name, serial number, date, extension ...), Starting serial #, Windows / Mac OS / Unix compatibility. Errors: Stop for Errors or Log Errors to File.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Conditional Mode Change
cards.summary: Converts the open document to a chosen color mode only if its current mode is one of the ticked source modes, so an action can force e.g. RGB without failing on files that are already RGB or in another mode. The pixels change only by the mode conversion itself.
use_for: the first step of a batch action that must work on a mixed folder of CMYK, grayscale and RGB files
forcing every web-bound image to RGB before Save for Web
avoid: one-off conversions of a single known file: Image > Mode is quicker
print-critical CMYK conversion: the conversion uses the current color settings, so check the profile with Edit > Convert to Profile instead

Same job in the object model (unverified): if (doc.mode != DocumentMode.RGB) doc.changeMode(ChangeMode.RGB) (harvested Document.changeMode, ChangeMode GRAYSCALE / RGB / CMYK / LAB / BITMAP / INDEXEDCOLOR / MULTICHANNEL).
cards.how: Source Mode: tick the modes to convert from (Bitmap, Grayscale, Duotone, Indexed Color, RGB Color, CMYK Color, Lab Color, Multichannel), with All / None buttons. Target Mode: the mode to convert to. Usually recorded into an action that will be batched.

an overview print of a folder of textures or stock picks
avoid: a designed layout or moodboard: build it by placing linked images on a grid by hand or with artboards
very large folders: one sheet per page of thumbnails can produce many heavy documents

cards.name: Fit Image

use_for: shrinking a mixed folder of portrait and landscape photos to a 2048 px bounding box for web
fitting product shots inside a marketplace's maximum pixel size
avoid: an exact output size such as 1080x1350: Fit Image keeps the aspect ratio, so crop with the Crop tool or Canvas Size afterwards

cards.script_api: No menu route harvested. Object model: doc.exportDocument(File(path), ExportType.ILLUSTRATORPATHS, opts) with opts = new ExportOptionsIllustrator() and opts.path = IllustratorPathType.ALLPATHS / DOCUMENTBOUNDS / NAMEDPATH (for NAMEDPATH also set opts.pathName) (harvested Document.exportDocument, ExportOptionsIllustrator path / pathName, IllustratorPathType; behaviour unverified).
cards.how: Write: Document Bounds, All Paths or one named path, then choose the file name and folder in the save dialog. Open the .ai in Illustrator and apply fills and strokes there.

review.changes: script_api: added opts.pathName, which NAMEDPATH needs (harvested ExportOptionsIllustrator member)

cards.name: Quick Export as PNG
cards.summary: Exports the document (or each artboard) immediately as a PNG using the Export Preferences defaults, without the Export As dialog; the menu label follows the Quick Export format set in those preferences. The PSD is not changed.
use_for: one-click PNG of a social post or icon while iterating
fast transparent PNG exports of artboards into an assets folder
avoid: exports needing a specific size, scale or JPG quality: use Export As
unattended runs when the preference is set to ask for a location: a save dialog appears
cards.script_api: No menu route harvested. Object model for a similar PNG output (unverified): doc.exportDocument(File(path), ExportType.SAVEFORWEB, opts) with ExportOptionsSaveForWeb set to PNG (harvested classes); the Action Manager event recorded for quick export is believed to be exportDocumentAsFileTypePressed (unverified).

review.changes: none

cards.name: Render Video
cards.summary: Renders the document's Timeline (a video timeline or a frame animation) to a video file or an image sequence. The document is not changed; output quality depends on the chosen encoder settings.
use_for: exporting an animated banner or social loop built on the Photoshop timeline as MP4
rendering a frame animation to a PNG sequence for an editor
avoid: animated GIFs for web: use Save for Web with GIF
longer edits with audio and transitions: build them in Premiere Pro or After Effects
cards.script_api: No menu route harvested; no harvested object-model call renders video.
cards.how: Name and folder (optionally a new subfolder). Adobe Media Encoder output: format (H.264, QuickTime, DPX) with preset, size, frame rate, field order, aspect, color management; or Photoshop Image Sequence with format, starting number and digits. Range: all frames, a frame range or the work area. Render Options: alpha channel.

review.changes: how: removed the '3D quality' render option (3D features are gone from current Photoshop and nothing in the harvest shows the option)

cards.name: Save for Web
cards.summary: Opens the classic Save for Web dialog: optimizes and previews the document as GIF, JPEG, PNG-8, PNG-24 or WBMP with side-by-side quality / file-size comparisons, then saves the optimized file. The PSD is not changed.
use_for: animated GIF export of a timeline animation
squeezing a banner JPEG under a size limit while comparing quality settings
indexed PNG-8 or GIF with a limited palette
avoid: multi-scale exports for apps and responsive web: use Export As
very large images: the dialog warns and gets slow; export with Export As or Save As
cards.script_api: app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('saveForWeb')) is the label-matched candidate that opens the dialog (not confirmed; the harvest skipped exports). Object model: doc.exportDocument(File(path), ExportType.SAVEFORWEB, opts) with new ExportOptionsSaveForWeb() (format, quality, colors, dither, transparency ...) (harvested classes; behaviour unverified).
cards.how: 2-Up / 4-Up previews with file size and download time. Preset or format; JPEG: quality, progressive, blur, matte; GIF / PNG-8: color reduction, number of colors, dither, transparency and matte, lossy (GIF); Convert to sRGB and metadata; Image Size and animation looping for GIF. Save writes images (and HTML when slices are used).

review.changes: none

cards.name: File Info
cards.summary: Opens the File Info dialog to view and edit the document's metadata (title, author, description, keywords, copyright, IPTC, camera and GPS data, raw XMP). Pixels are not changed; the metadata is written when the file is saved.
use_for: stamping copyright and creator details into client deliverables
adding keywords and descriptions for stock submissions
avoid: exports that strip metadata (Export As or Save for Web set to none): check the export's metadata option
batch metadata stamping: set DocumentInfo fields by script instead of the dialog
cards.script_api: app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('fileInfo')) opens the dialog (run live 2026-10-04). Without UI: app.activeDocument.info.title / author / caption / keywords / copyrighted / copyrightNotice / ownerUrl (harvested DocumentInfo) or app.activeDocument.xmpMetadata (harvested XMPMetadata; editing behaviour unverified).
cards.how: Basic: Document Title, Author, Author Title, Description, Rating, Keywords, Copyright Status, Copyright Notice and Copyright Info URL. Other sections: Camera Data, Origin, IPTC, IPTC Extension, GPS Data, Audio / Video data, Photoshop, DICOM and Raw Data. Metadata templates can be saved and imported.

review.changes: none
